relevance_note: Single case report of a woman with a LAMP2 variant: "WES gene testing revealed a pathogenic heterozygous variant in LAMP2 gene (c.696T>A; p.Cys232Ter), which confirmed the diagnosis of Danon disease".
method_note: Hand extraction; a short script only assembled the JSON. One in-scope person (the single unnamed patient, label 'patient'). Relatives (parents who 'died of other diseases than cardiac', a 27-year-old son 'described as healthy', no siblings) are neither tested nor affected, so given no rows. Age at diagnosis taken from the abstract sentence tying age 51 to the late genetic diagnosis; age at last evaluation is the 51 years at admission. Variant type 'nonsense' taken from 'changes the amino acid from a cysteine to a stop codon' (the word 'nonsense' is not printed). No parental testing (parents deceased, not tested). 'Echocardiography at that time showed a normal heart' and 'no ... abnormalities of other systems found in physical examination' are whole-exam normals and exclude nothing specific. 'no other clinical manifestations of extracardiac impairment', 'socially well-adjusted' and a negative EMG were not used to exclude any specific checklist item (muscle weakness, cognitive items etc. left not reported). Troponin-T was normal three years earlier and markedly increased at this admission: a change over time, not a contradiction; both rows emitted with timing in severity_or_detail. CK elevation inferred from the printed value above the printed reference range. NT-proBNP units are inconsistent in the paper (568 pg/mL vs reference 0-227 ng/L). No contradictions found.
